purpose: generation-context diagnostic dump; not a native PSM or external profile
method: wrap original build_context and Jinja Template.render, return original unchanged; record runtime Python types and all context entries
object_limitations: For non-JSON textX objects, parent and _tx internals omitted to avoid cycles; repeated references retain ref paths. Plain context JSON is lossless when present. Read audit observes Python open events, not OS syscalls.
